findings.description: AWS access key material is embedded in Lambda environment variables in Terraform. The secret is stored in source/configuration state and is exposed to users or systems able to read the function configuration or Terraform state.

The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life Lambda runtime that no longer receives security updates, leaving the function dependent on an unsupported runtime with known or future unpatched vulnerabilities.
